name: Optical Flow Loss for 3D Gaussian Reconstruction
definition: A technique to improve 3D shape reconstruction of static objects from video sequences by incorporating optical flow as a loss term, leveraging the temporal prior in video data to resolve concavity/convexity ambiguities present in silhouette and color loss terms.
summary: Optical Flow Loss for 3D Gaussian Reconstruction improves 3D shape reconstruction from video by using optical flow to resolve concavity ambiguities and handle lighting changes.
